attributes.description: Distribution opsdir-adapter-bmc-helix (import opsdir_adapter_bmc_helix), registered via entry point opsdir.adapters:bmc-helix; depends on opsdir.
attributes.external_dependencies: ["BMC AR System REST API (GET /api/arsys/v1/entry/CHG:Infrastructure Change, /api/arsys/v1/entry/AP:Detail-Signature, /api/arsys/v1/entry/WOI:WorkOrderInterface, read-only; drafts target POST /api/arsys/v1/entry/WOI:WorkOrderInterface_Create, posted by a person, never by opsdir)"]
attributes.purpose: BMC Helix ITSM / Remedy as an ITSM add-on (kind itsm). It reads the change tickets the record's change records link (bmc-helix:<Infrastructure Change ID>) as evidence. Importer bmc-helix/change-requests reads AR System REST answers of CHG:Infrastructure Change and AP:Detail-Signature, mapping statuses through the setting bmc-helix-status-states (BMC's documented list by default). The approval is rejected on status Rejected and otherwise derived from the signatures grouped by Approval ID. A read-only collector uses an AR-JWT or bearer token minted outside opsdir. Task 612: drafts the work orders that hand findings to owning teams (drafts.py, Adapter.ticket_draft: WOI:WorkOrderInterface_Create bodies a person posts; settings bmc-helix-ticket-groups, bmc-helix-ticket-fields) and reads linked work orders (WO...) back as work tickets from WOI:WorkOrderInterface (workorders.py; setting bmc-helix-work-order-states).

attributes.name: ticket_facts
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "entry", "type": "dict", "required": true}, {"name": "signatures", "type": "tuple[dict] | None", "required": true}, {"name": "states", "type": "dict[str, str]", "required": true, "description": "{status: neutral state}"}]
attributes.purpose: The ticket attributes of one CHG:Infrastructure Change entry and its signatures (None: approvals not read): neutral state by the status map, overall approval, native state, change type from Change Timing, planned/work windows (offset date-times, date-only refused), steps, approver rows, facts, provider ref, doc URL, title; and the problems to name.

attributes.name: read_changes
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "files", "type": "dict[str, str]", "required": true}, {"name": "d", "type": "Directory", "required": true}, {"name": "patterns", "type": "tuple", "required": true}, {"name": "at", "type": "datetime | None", "required": false, "description": "when the export was taken"}]
attributes.purpose: The importer bmc-helix/change-requests reads saved AR System REST answers into the record's ticket evidence: each linked change (CHG:Infrastructure Change with its AP:Detail-Signature pages) and each linked work order (WO..., WOI:WorkOrderInterface, read as a work ticket via workorders.work_order_facts and bmc-helix-work-order-states) becomes its own import group, which replaces only that ticket. Notices name: unmapped statuses (per setting), incomplete approvals, other applications' signatures, unlinked tickets, linked tickets the export lacks, errors and non-answers. An export spanning several servers is refused, and so is an undated one.

attributes.name: change_steps
attributes.purpose: The collector's calls: a qualified read (limit 2) of CHG:Infrastructure Change for each linked change and of WOI:WorkOrderInterface (by Work Order ID) for each linked work order (WO...); then, for each change read, the AP:Detail-Signature pages (the Request ID or the CRQ), each after a page that links a next one. Work orders get no approval read.

attributes.name: team_groups
attributes.purpose: The support group (Support Company, Support Organization, Support Group Name) each owning team's work orders are assigned to, from the estate setting bmc-helix-ticket-groups ('<team>=<company>/<organization>/<group>, ...'); malformed values named and left out.

attributes.name: ticket_fields
attributes.purpose: The other values of every BMC Helix work-order draft, from bmc-helix-ticket-fields ('<field>=<value>, ...'); fields opsdir sets itself (OWNED) are named and left out.

attributes.name: due_time
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "day", "type": "date | None", "required": true, "description": "the earliest do-by date, or None"}]
attributes.purpose: The end of a do-by day in UTC as an AR System ISO 8601 date-time (Scheduled End Date of a work-order draft).

attributes.name: priority
attributes.purpose: A work-order draft's Priority: bmc-helix-ticket-fields' Priority when it is Critical, High, Medium or Low, else High when the findings hold a blocker and Medium otherwise; an invalid given one is a problem.

attributes.name: work_order_values
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "request", "type": "TicketRequest", "required": true, "description": "the team's findings"}, {"name": "group", "type": "tuple", "required": true, "description": "(Support Company, Support Organization, Support Group Name)"}, {"name": "fields", "type": "dict", "required": true, "description": "ticket_fields' values"}]
attributes.purpose: The values of a WOI:WorkOrderInterface_Create request for one team's findings: the given fields, then z1D_Action CREATE, Summary, Detailed Description (request_lines), Status Assigned, the support group, Priority and Scheduled End Date.
attributes.returns: {"type": "dict", "description": "{field: value} of the create body's values"}

attributes.name: ticket_draft
attributes.purpose: Adapter.ticket_draft of the BMC Helix add-on: one team's findings as a work-order create body (JSON file a person posts with their own AR-JWT), or None with problems naming the setting to give (no support group for the team in bmc-helix-ticket-groups, a foundation field missing from bmc-helix-ticket-fields); how = request line, curl with credential placeholders, notes.
attributes.returns: {"type": "TicketDraft", "description": "TicketDraft(body JSON text or None, 'json', HOW, problems)"}

attributes.name: is_work_order
attributes.purpose: Whether a linked bmc-helix ticket number names a work order (it starts with BMC's Work Order ID prefix WO), not a change.

attributes.name: window_times
attributes.purpose: The schedule fields (Scheduled/Actual Start/End Date) work orders and change tickets share, as GeneralizedTime per ticket window attribute, with why a value isn't a date-time.
attributes.returns: {"type": "dict", "description": "{ticket attribute: (GeneralizedTime or None, why not or None)}"}

attributes.name: work_order_facts
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "values", "type": "dict", "required": true, "description": "the work order's values"}, {"name": "url", "type": "str | None", "required": true, "description": "its REST self link"}, {"name": "states", "type": "dict", "required": true, "description": "{Status: neutral state} of bmc-helix-work-order-states"}]
attributes.purpose: One BMC Helix work order (WOI:WorkOrderInterface values) as a work ticket's attributes: ciamTicketKind work, state via the status map, native state, planned and work windows, ciamTicketDue from Scheduled End Date, facts (status reason, priority, type, last modified), Request ID, self link, title.

attributes.description: Package opsdir-adapter-bmc-helix only. (1) Adapter.ticket_draft: body = {"values": {...}} for POST /api/arsys/v1/entry/WOI%3AWorkOrderInterface_Create: z1D_Action CREATE, Summary (title), Detailed Description (correct spelling; request_lines), Status Assigned, Support Company / Support Organization / Support Group Name (mapped per team), Priority (Critical|High|Medium|Low), Scheduled End Date (earliest do-by, ISO 8601; propagation on create unconfirmed: say so in how/README), plus required foundation defaults (First Name, Last Name, Customer First/Last Name, Company, Customer Company, Location Company) from a setting; settings without defaults: bmc-helix-ticket-groups ('<team>=<company>/<organization>/<group>'), bmc-helix-ticket-fields ('<field>=<value>' defaults); missing -> problems naming the setting. how = request line + curl with AR-JWT placeholder. (2) Read-back: linked work-order ids (WO...) are read from the work-order form (not CHG:Infrastructure Change) as ciamTicketKind=work, state via a mapping setting (bmc-helix-work-order-states '<status>=<neutral state>'), Scheduled End -> ciamTicketDue, planned/actual windows when present. Unit tests. README.
attributes.name: 612c BMC Helix: work-order draft (WOI:WorkOrderInterface_Create) + read-back
